name: Arithmetic crossover
lesson: Arithmetic crossover only makes points on the line between the parents, so without mutation the population can only shrink toward its centre.
lookFor: Mutation is off, to show crossover alone. With this seed the box around the population never grows, it shrinks to a point, and Run until stop pauses at generation 56 for stagnation with the best so far 0.976, short of the top of the hill (fitness 1). In all 100 runs (seeds 1 to 100) the box never grows; 17 reach ε and 80 stop for stagnation.
